what the design tool answered

Same 80 mm envelope, same 48 V rail. Switch tasks and watch the winding, magnets, back-iron, and gearbox change. Impulse tasks (jump, sprint) get few-turn, thin-iron windings built to dump a peak and cool off; continuous tasks (carry, pick) get many turns, thick iron, and a taller gear stack to hold torque without overheating.
